purpose: Discovery-only records for instruments that refer to or implement Labour Law No. 14/2025. These are not certified amendments and are not imported automatically.

instruments.title_ar: قرار رئيس مجلس الوزراء رقم 2652 لسنة 2026
instruments.observed_effect: Extends by six months the period for private employment agencies covered by the final paragraph of Article 6 of Law 14/2025 to regularize their status.
instruments.source_text_review: Official Amiri Press text page located and reviewed. It is dated 2026-09-07, extends the period for specified private employment agencies under the final paragraph of Article 6 of Law 14/2025 by six months, and Article 2 directs publication in the Official Gazette. No separate commencement clause was found in the retrieved text; Gazette issue/page and the date from which the six-month extension runs must be established from the published instrument and reviewed by counsel. Do not infer an effective date from the issuance date.

instruments.title_ar: قرار وزارة العمل رقم 74 لسنة 2026 بشأن تنظيم عمل مراصد سوق العمل
instruments.observed_effect: Regulates labour-market observatories; its preamble cites Law 14/2025 among other legal authorities.
instruments.gazette_issue_and_pages: Egyptian Gazette Supplement issue 108, published 2026-05-17; exact page range not reviewed.
instruments.source_text_review: Official Amiri Press text page located and reviewed: the decision is dated 2026-04-15, its Article 17 states it is published in the Egyptian Gazette and takes effect the day after publication, and the official DSpace catalogue identifies issue 108 dated 2026-05-17 as containing Decisions 74 and 75/2026. The derived 2026-05-18 effective date is a metadata calculation, not lawyer approval. Exact Gazette page range and reuse permission remain unknown.
